notes: oven: front panels scaled x1.05 to fill the 0.91 m body; no back panel exists on the sheet (left open); sides use panels 24/25 (A's order used 26)
fridge: depth converted from the supplied grayscale map, relative to each view's median; no corner panels exist, so the rounded cabinet edges cannot be represented

crown: profile authored as a row-by-row relief (a heightfield cannot undercut, so the cove is approximated); the painted strip is one rectangle: it is stretched over 1.2 m rather than repeated; no ends, top or underside
tv: the five split views laid out side by side as one atlas (paint unchanged); screen recess and knobs authored by rules; the curved screen bulge is not represented
armchair: nine panels positioned by hand from typical armchair proportions; cushion relief authored as soft bulges; no legs, arm tops or inner arm faces (no panels painted for them)
